title: i18n: a field's translated help never shows when the field authors inlineHelpText — the server serves fields.FIELD.help on description and the console draws inlineHelpText first
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面 + HTTP，zh-CN 会话打开联系人编辑表单，两个新浏览器上下文各实测一次）
业务理由: 中文用户打开 showcase 联系人表单，其余标签都是中文，唯独「线索评分」下的帮助说明是英文，像漏翻；凡是作者写了 `inlineHelpText` 的字段（Studio 字段面板写的正是这个键），翻译过的帮助在任何语言下都被源文遮住，翻译包白写。清单项 i18n.surface-matrix 的 negative[1] 因此失败，发版清单一直红。
动手的读者: 拥有 `packages/spec` i18n 解析器（`translateObject`）的车道：把 `fields.FIELD.help` 的译文也落到字段作者写的 `inlineHelpText` 上（或由 `ui/packages/fields` 改读译文槽）。先定一个契约：译后的帮助住在哪个槽；抽取器、翻译器、控制台三处同一推导。
查重: `inlineHelpText translation` 9 命中、`inlineHelpText zh-CN` 6、`translated help description inlineHelpText console` 5、`lead_score help` 5（含已关）；近邻 #25683（CLI 抽取 help 的来源，已关，正是它造成此漂移）、#21948（服务端把 help 写在未声明键上，已关），无开着的重复。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · i18n.surface-matrix · negative[1]

## What happens
On a zh-CN session, the showcase contact Edit form shows the `lead_score` help line in English, "Computed by scoring rules — not user-editable.", although the zh-CN bundle carries `objects.showcase_contact.fields.lead_score.help = 由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。`.

`GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_contact` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` serves `fields.lead_score` as `{inlineHelpText: "Computed by scoring rules — not user-editable.", description: "由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。"}`, and the console's help reader picks `inlineHelpText`.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot, console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; sign in as admin; avatar menu → Language → 中文（中国）(writes `sys_user.locale = zh-CN`).
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_contact?form=CONTACT_ID` (any contact; the default form).
3. **Expected:** the 线索评分 help line reads `由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。`.
4. **Actual:** `Computed by scoring rules — not user-editable.`

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
- `translateObject` serves the bundle's field `help` only on `description` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:4446-4452`); its docblock (~:4383-4394) says help is "not served on inlineHelpText either, which the extractor never reads".
- Since #25683 the extractor does read it: `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:1458-1464` scaffolds `fields.FIELD.help` from `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description`.
- The console's one help reader, `ui/packages/fields/src/fieldHelpText.ts:53`, returns `inlineHelpText || description`.

So for any field that authors `inlineHelpText`, the translated help is shadowed by the source text in every locale.
